sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default when a value is absent — and the type system enforcing you must choose what fills the emptiness
Erlang's process linking: when two processes are linked, if one dies, the other receives an exit signal and dies too — unless it explicitly traps exits
Ruby's frozen string: calling .freeze on a string makes it permanently immutable — any attempt to modify it raises a RuntimeError
